gloss: grasping; mastery (of a knack or skill)

definitions.gloss: grasping; getting the knack of; mastery
definitions.explanation: Fully understanding something and making it one's own, especially a knack, technique, or the essence of an art. A written, somewhat formal word; as {会得|えとく}する it means to master or get the hang of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{会得|えとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To get the knack of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独学|どくがく}→独学：09601_dokugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{会得|えとく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He mastered the basics of cooking on his own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、ようやく⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{会得|えとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After years of practice, I was finally able to master my teacher's technique.

notes:
Note the reading: え, not かい as in ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧. The object is usually a knack, a technique, or the heart of something (⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧, ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧, ⟦{要領|ようりょう}→要領：14109_youryou⟧, ⟦{極意|ごくい}→極意：16010_gokui⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{会得|えとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get the knack
- ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{会得|えとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to master a technique
- ⟦{極意|ごくい}→極意：16010_gokui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{会得|えとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grasp the secret of an art

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{習得|しゅうとく}→習得：13903_shuutoku⟧: acquiring a skill or language by study; the neutral, more common word
- ⟦{体得|たいとく}→体得：17210_taitoku⟧: mastering something through bodily experience
- ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧: understanding in general, without the sense of making a skill one's own
